Spring Has Sprung

Wed, May 1, 2019 · 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM · Piggy Bank

When

Where

IAmMoody presents the 1st Annual “Spring Has Sprung” Fashion Week MN show on Wednesday, May 1st.  #FashionWeekMN

Producing fashion shows in the Twin Cities for 30 years, IAmMoody is starting a new annual FWMN Spring show. This runway show will highlight Spring collections from the best new local designers and iconic Minneapolis boutique Local Motion in a high-energy runway show, showcased by Minnesota’s top models of diverse ethnicities and genders.
